title: Anesthesia Unit Rate — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Outpatient Surgery Agreements
content:
The anesthesia lines (revenue code 0370) of an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carry a rate per counted unit of 640.00 USD on a Commercial PPO Claim, 720.00 USD on a Commercial HMO Claim, and otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) their charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage. They are valued at their counted units times that rate, never above their charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Basis questions (hypothetical):
- *3 units on a Commercial PPO Claim, charges 3,000.00?* 1,920.00.
- *3 units on a Commercial HMO Claim, charges 1,800.00?* 2,160.00 exceeds the charges, so 1,800.00.
